label_requirements: Separate +5% and +10% underlying-price returns; never leveraged ROI.
Entry must be observable after a signal; no hindsight entry at a local low.
Report first target-touch time and maximum adverse excursion before touch or horizon.
Missing or immature outcomes are unknown; never negatives or unlimited eventual wins.
Show every exploratory horizon; do not report the best horizon as held-out performance.
Freeze signal, horizon and failure rules before a separate chronological evaluation.
No stop or liquidation rule registered; price-touch rates are not strategy win rates.
Fees, funding and execution costs are required before claiming net strategy returns.
legacy_comparison: Separate study; not an improvement claim over the original 114-symbol +15% surge target.
operations: Public orderbook/trade collection only; existing observation thresholds are unvalidated for NEAR futures. No prediction model, orders or daemon.
